title: Kubernetes Service Discovery
description: Use Kubernetes native service discovery with Services and DNS.

data.text: Kubernetes provides built-in service discovery through Services and DNS. Each service gets a stable DNS name and virtual IP, making discovery automatic.

terms.definition: An abstraction that provides a stable IP and DNS name for a set of pods.
The default service type, exposing the service on an internal IP.
The DNS server that resolves service names in Kubernetes.
The network location of a pod backing a service.

items: NodePort: expose on a node port
Headless: direct pod IPs, no proxy

data.text: Kubernetes DNS resolves service names. The format is <service-name>.<namespace>.svc.cluster.local. Within the same namespace, just the service name works.

data.caption: Kubernetes Service Discovery
data.definition:
flowchart TD
    Pod1[Pod A] -->|Label: app=catalog| Svc[Service]
    Pod2[Pod B] -->|Label: app=catalog| Svc
    Pod3[Pod C] -->|Label: app=catalog| Svc
    Svc -->|ClusterIP| EP[(Endpoints)]
    Client[Client Pod] -->|DNS: catalog| DNS[CoreDNS]
    DNS -->|ClusterIP| Client
    Client -->|Request| Svc

data.title: Kubernetes Service YAML
data.content: A ClusterIP service for the catalog service.
data.code:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: catalog-service
  namespace: production
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app: catalog
  ports:
    - port: 80
      targetPort: 5000
      protocol: TCP
      name: http

items.question: Does Kubernetes need a separate registry?
items.answer: No. Kubernetes Services and DNS provide discovery natively.

items.question: What is a headless service?
items.answer: A service without a ClusterIP that returns pod IPs directly, used for stateful services.

items.question: How does kube-proxy work?
items.answer: kube-proxy installs iptables rules or uses IPVS to route traffic to service endpoints.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Kubernetes provides native discovery via Services and DNS
Each service gets a stable DNS name
data.takeaway: Kubernetes makes service discovery automatic through Services and DNS.
